query: SELECT player_character.agent_id FROM world_member JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = world_member.id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = player_character.character_id JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id JOIN character_presence ON character_presence.character_id = player_character.character_id WHERE world_member.world_id = ? AND world_member.access = 'active' AND "group".id = ? AND character_presence.absent_since IS NULL ORDER BY player_character.agent_id
